snippet.title: Crimson Moon - Summer Game Fest Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Crimson Moon now and join the crusade:
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4317690/Crimson_Moon/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=crimson_moon_august&utm_term=crimson_moon_august_sku&utm_content=crimson_moon_august_sku_youtube
- PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013260?utm_source=playstation&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=crimson_moon_august&utm_term=crimson_moon_august_sku&utm_content=crimson_moon_august_sku_youtube
- Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/crimson-moon/9nmdsxmvqtn4?msockid=394c7ee64a706a801f6169e34b4f6bbd&utm_source=xbox&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=crimson_moon_august&utm_term=crimson_moon_august_sku&utm_content=crimson_moon_august_sku_youtube
- Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/p/crimson-moon-b329bd?lang=en-US&utm_source=egs&utm_medium=organic-social&utm_campaign=crimson_moon_august&utm_term=crimson_moon_august_sku&utm_content=crimson_moon_august_sku_youtube

Enter the fallen city of Gildenarch and face new enemies and brutal battles, while mastering powerful Nephilim abilities across a dark, replayable world built for relentless hunts and unforgettable encounters. 

Fight alone or bring a second Nephilim into battle as you push deeper into the city and uncover what waits beyond.  

Join our Discord to follow development, share theories, meet the community, and get updates before anywhere else: https://discord.gg/playcrimsonmoon
